proactive_opportunities.title: Make supported-version choice and lifecycle guidance scannable on the download route
proactive_opportunities.rationale: The homepage announces six release lines and separately warns that PostgreSQL 14 stops receiving fixes on November 12, 2026; the downloads page then asks visitors to choose an operating-system family. A compact, linked support-status cue beside the version or download choice would help a new installer connect the release announcement with the production-safety qualifier.
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Place current-supported and testing-only labels, plus a link to versioning policy, next to the version/download decision point so extracted answers preserve the version qualifier and next step.
proactive_opportunities.verification: On https://www.postgresql.org/download/ and the linked versioning policy, each listed release line has an unambiguous support or testing status and the status remains readable in source text.

readiness.detail: Homepage, About, Documentation, and Downloads returned HTTP 200. robots.txt permits the sampled paths for Googlebot, bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot; account/admin and other utility paths are disallowed by wildcard rules.
Static source extraction captured headings and material passages describing PostgreSQL, documentation manuals, release lines, download packages, and testing-only builds.
The sampled visitor questions are answerable from the inspected first-party pages, with the version-choice interaction left untested because no browser was permitted.
